areaGuide.title: Living in Ampang – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Condo & Apartment Rental in Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: Ampang is one of Kuala Lumpur's most established and highly desirable residential locations for room rental, condominium rental and apartment rental. Located just east of Kuala Lumpur City Centre, Ampang offers an attractive combination of premium residential developments, international communities, excellent amenities, healthcare facilities, shopping destinations and convenient access to KLCC, Bukit Bintang and major business districts. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Ampang, a single room near Ampang LRT, a fully furnished condo room, a luxury serviced apartment, a studio apartment or an affordable room rental, Ampang provides accommodation options suitable for professionals, expatriates, students, couples and families. The area is especially popular among executives working in KLCC, Tun Razak Exchange (TRX), Jalan Ampang and major corporate offices due to its strategic location and excellent connectivity. Residents enjoy easy access to Ampang LRT Station, Jelatek LRT Station, Dato Keramat LRT Station, MRR2, Jalan Ampang and major highways connecting Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley. Popular landmarks including Ampang Point Shopping Centre, Great Eastern Mall, Gleneagles Hospital Kuala Lumpur, KPJ Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital, KLCC Park and Jalan Ampang continue to make Ampang one of the most sought-after rental markets in Kuala Lumpur.
